snippet.title: Bedrotting Simulator - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3963500/Bedrotting_Simulator/

A high-intensity survival horror/resource-management game about late-night calls, desperate defenses, and a collapsing relationship. Argue, comfort, and compromise to keep your e-girlfriend from leaving—then barricade doors, set traps, and fend off demons.

ixavon - 2026
